Deeply negative retained earnings (-6,947M) signal a history of losses, increasing default risk. These factors, combined with moderate leverage (debt-to-equity ≈ 1.00), place the issuer firmly in speculative grade, specifically B+, due to ongoing operational viability (positive EBIT) but elevated liquidity and profitability concerns.

DECISION: B+
